slides.headline: Viewing a house this weekend?
slides.body: 3 things most buyers forget to check.
slides.say: Viewing a house in George this weekend? Here are three things most buyers forget to check.

slides.headline: Open every tap
slides.body: Low pressure and slow drains are cheap to spot and expensive to fix.
slides.say: One. Open every tap. Low water pressure and slow drains are cheap to spot, and expensive to fix.

slides.headline: Look up
slides.body: Stains on ceilings can point to roof leaks.
slides.say: Two. Look up. Stains on the ceiling can point to a leaking roof.

slides.headline: Ask what stays
slides.body: Curtains, light fittings, the pool pump. Get it in writing.
slides.say: Three. Ask what stays. Curtains, light fittings, the pool pump. Get it in writing.

slides.say: Want the full checklist? Send me a DM with the word check, and I'll send it to you for free.
